An invented eight-digit contact split across four spans passes both the privacy assertion and minimized-structure assertion when appended to list-1.html; concatenated DOM text reconstructs the contact. This is a compositional bypass, not the prior whole-element exemption or prefix-match bug.

This is outside the requested parsed-value contract and is not a current fixture leak; rejecting malformed closing syntax would be optional raw-source hardening.
